name: MACD Four Colors 2 Martingale
summary: This EA trades based on a four-color MACD indicator signal and employs a martingale position-sizing strategy, doubling the lot size after each losing trade. It enters long when MACD turns bullish (color change) and short when MACD turns bearish, with the martingale layer intended to recover losses from prior trades. The strategy relies on eventual mean reversion of price to close the martingale chain in profit.
summary_zh: 该EA基于四色MACD指标信号进行交易，并采用马丁格尔仓位管理策略，在每次亏损后将手数翻倍。当MACD转为看涨颜色时做多，转为看跌颜色时做空，马丁格尔层级旨在回收先前交易的亏损。策略依赖价格最终回归以实现马丁格尔链整体盈利。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是利用四色MACD指标判断趋势方向与动量变化，通过颜色切换作为入场信号。入场条件为：当MACD柱状图从负转正且颜色变为看涨色时开多单，从正转负且颜色变为看跌色时开空单。出场条件通常依赖止盈目标或MACD反向信号，但马丁格尔机制意味着亏损后不会止损出场，而是加倍仓位反向或同向再开单。仓位管理采用经典马丁格尔法，每次亏损后手数翻倍（乘以2或可配置倍数），试图用一次大盈利覆盖所有前序亏损。资金管理方面，缺乏硬性止损是最大隐患，账户可能在连续亏损中因保证金不足而爆仓。整体策略属于高风险高回报类型，短期看似稳定盈利，但黑天鹅事件下存在账户归零风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept uses a four-color MACD indicator to determine trend direction and momentum shifts, with color transitions serving as entry signals. Entry conditions: open a long position when the MACD histogram turns from negative to positive and changes to a bullish color, and open a short position when it turns from positive to negative with a bearish color. Exit conditions typically rely on a take-profit target or a reverse MACD signal, but the martingale mechanism means losing trades are not closed with a stop-loss; instead, the lot size is doubled on the next trade to recover losses. Position sizing follows the classic martingale method, multiplying the lot size by a configurable factor (typically 2x) after each loss, attempting to cover all prior losses with a single winning trade. Money management is the weakest point, as the absence of a hard stop-loss creates existential risk — the account can be wiped out during a prolonged losing streak when margin is exhausted. The strategy appears profitable in the short term but carries catastrophic tail risk during black swan events.

pros: 四色MACD提供比传统双色MACD更细腻的趋势与动量判断，入场信号更明确
马丁格尔策略在震荡行情中能快速回收亏损并实现整体盈利，短期回测表现亮眼
设有最大订单层数限制，一定程度上约束了马丁格尔的无限扩张风险
pros_en: The four-color MACD provides more nuanced trend and momentum readings than traditional two-color MACD, yielding clearer entry signals
The martingale approach can recover losses quickly in ranging markets and produce consistent short-term profits in backtesting
A maximum order layer limit partially constrains the unlimited expansion risk inherent in martingale systems
cons: 马丁格尔策略在强趋势行情中会导致手数指数级增长，极易爆仓归零
默认止损为0，缺乏硬性止损保护，单次极端行情即可摧毁账户
四色MACD信号在低波动或横盘市场中频繁切换颜色，产生大量虚假信号导致反复亏损
没有考虑点差和佣金成本，马丁格尔链条越长交易成本越高，实际盈利门槛更高
cons_en: The martingale strategy causes lot sizes to grow exponentially during strong trending markets, easily leading to margin call and account wipeout
Default stop-loss is zero, lacking hard stop-loss protection — a single extreme move can destroy the entire account
The four-color MACD signal frequently switches colors in low-volatility or sideways markets, generating many false signals and repeated losses
Spread and commission costs are not factored in; longer martingale chains incur progressively higher transaction costs, raising the actual breakeven threshold
improvements: 增加硬性止损机制，即使使用马丁格尔也应设置账户级别的最大回撤止损以保护本金
加入点差过滤和新K线检查，避免在高点差环境下重复开仓或在同一根K线内多次交易
考虑将纯马丁格尔改为有限步进的逆势加仓策略，并结合趋势过滤器避免在强趋势中逆势加仓
improvements_en: Add a hard stop-loss mechanism — even with martingale, an account-level maximum drawdown stop should protect capital
Implement spread filtering and new bar checking to avoid opening positions during high-spread conditions or trading multiple times on the same bar
Consider replacing pure martingale with a limited-step counter-trend pyramiding strategy combined with a trend filter to avoid adding positions against strong trends

risk_points: 马丁格尔手数指数级增长，连续亏损后仓位远超账户承受能力，存在爆仓风险
默认无止损，极端行情下单笔亏损无上限
无点差过滤，高波动时段点差扩大加剧亏损
无新K线检查可能导致同一K线内重复开仓
risk_points_en: Martingale lot sizes grow exponentially; after consecutive losses, position size far exceeds account capacity, creating margin call risk
No stop-loss by default means unlimited per-trade loss in extreme market conditions
No spread filter — widening spreads during volatile sessions amplify losses
No new bar check may cause repeated position opening within the same candle
